messages:
Maya (Support): FYI — FinAcct from sales asked for better trace->cost linkage. They want sampling controls in console so they can surface traces for most expensive per-tenant/route traffic. They filed an ask yesterday: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-321

Alice (PM): Can you paste the customer's exact ask? How urgent — are they blocking a go-live?

Maya (Support): Copied from sales thread: "need per-tenant and per-route trace sampling + ability to link trace ids to per-request cost breakdowns in the console. Sampling should be configurable (0-100%) and support include/exclude by model/tag. Also OTA export to Datadog/Lightstep." They are not blocking but it's in their security/compliance checklist for rollout.

Ben (Sales): Confirm — FinAcct is willing to pay for feature if we ship within Q2. ACV ~ $200k. Main ask is for auditability in Private/Dedicated deployments.

Alice (PM): Ok. Proposed scope for initial ship:
- Console UI: sampling policy page (tenant, route, model, percentage slider)
- Backend: server-side sampler that annotates requests with trace_id and sampling decision
- Link traces in per-request cost drilldown (click -> trace view with trace_id)
- Telemetry events & metrics for sampled rate per-tenant
- Export hook for traced spans to customer's APM (configurable endpoint)

Acceptance criteria (draft):
1) Console shows sampling policy editor + list of policies
2) Sampled traces appear in cost drilldown with clickable trace_id
3) Sampling config enforces per-tenant RBAC and persists across restarts
4) Metrics: sampled_count, sampled_rate_by_tenant, dropped_by_policy
5) Tests: e2e for sample annotation + export to mock collector

Darren (Eng): Engineering notes:
- Use existing request id -> map to trace_id, add middleware in runtime to decide sample
- We can reuse telemetry pipeline for export; need to add span forwarding (GDPR check)
- Estimated effort: 3-4 sprints (2 eng + 1 infra) for Hosted + Dedicated. Private may add extra ~1 sprint for install scripts.

Eve (SRE): Observability concerns:
- Need quota to avoid exporting too many spans (customer could set 100% and flood APM)
- Default policy should be 0.1% global and per-tenant cap
- Retention and PII redaction rules must be clear in UI

Darren (Eng): Example config snippet:
```
policy: {
  tenant: "finacct",
  match: { route: "/v1/generate", model_tags: ["gpt-4x"] },
  rate: 0.05,
  export: "https://dd.example.com/ingest"
}
```

TelemetryBot: New event schema required: `trace_sampling_decision` {trace_id, tenant, route, model, decision, reason}

Alice (PM): Questions for scoping: minimal MVP w/o export? We could ship console UI + backend sampling + trace_id link (no export) in Q2 and add export in Q3. Opinions?

Ben (Sales): MVP without export works for FinAcct for now if we commit export in roadmap and provide a documentation workaround (manual s3 upload of spans).

Maya (Support): Customer ok with staged approach. Wants ETA and rollout plan, and confirmation it will work on Private.

Alice (PM): Plan:
- Milestone 1 (MVP): UI + backend sampling + trace link, basic metrics, RBAC (target: 6 weeks)
- Milestone 2 (Export + per-span PII redaction + caps): 8-10 weeks after M1
Owners: Alice (PM) -> spec, Darren -> eng lead, Eve -> SRE for caps/alerts, Maya -> customer comms

Action items:
- Darren: run spike for middleware + sample policy prototype (owner, due in 1 week)
- Eve: propose default cap values and alert thresholds (due 1 week)
- Alice: write PRD with acceptance criteria and rollout plan (due 5 days)
- Ben/Maya: confirm commercial commitment for timeline (due 3 days)

Alice (PM): I'll add this to roadmap candidate list for Q2 and tag as "enterprise-observability". If we get sign-off from FinAcct on commercial terms, we'll priority-rank it.

Maya (Support): noted, I'll ping FinAcct and confirm.

Darren (Eng): one more note — we should ensure sampling decision is deterministic for a request id range so the KV cache + batching doesn't drop trace info. Will include in spike.

Alice (PM): Great. I'll follow up with PRD link when ready.

Ben (Sales): :thumbsup:
